ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://online.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended. ArcGIS 10.3 software required. For GIS courses, dual monitors and high speed, wired internet access are HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. No textbook is required.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
